chunks: Ibn Abī ʿUmayr narrated from Jamīl ibn Darrāj from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
Regarding a man who freed his slave at the time of his death while he had a debt upon him
He عليه السلام said: “If his value is equal to what is due upon him, and equal to it again, his emancipation is valid; otherwise, it is not valid.”

key_terms.أَعْتَقَ: he emancipated or freed from bondage

ai.seo_question: Is freeing a slave at the time of death valid if the deceased still owed debts?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about emancipating a slave at the time of death when the dying person is in debt. The validity of the emancipation depends on the slave’s value in relation to the outstanding debt, showing that the rights of creditors are taken into account before such a disposal is upheld.
